description: Execute an available FavCRM tool by name after discovering it with search_tools. Target tool availability, input schema, module gates, and audit logging are still enforced.

arguments.description: Arguments object for the target tool. Must match the target input schema.

toolName.description: Exact target tool name returned by search_tools

name: execute_tool

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
